questions.question: Who among the following is the Chief Election Commissioner of India as of January 2021?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sunil Arora**__.

__
 
• **Sunil Arora is the Chief Election Commissioner of India as of January 2021.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chief Election Commissioner (CEC)**

 
 
• The President appoints the Chief Election Commissioner, who has a** tenure of 6 years, or up to the age of 65 years**, whichever is earlier.
 
• The CEC enjoys the** same status and the salary** and perks as available to **Judges of the Supreme Court.**
 
• The Chief Election Commissioner can be **removed from his office only in a manner and on the grounds prescribed for removal of Judge of the Supreme Court.**
 
• Other** Election Commissioners** can be removed by the **President **on the recommendation of the Chief Election Commissioner.
 
• The Election Commission has the power of superintendence, direction and conduct of all elections to Parliament and the State Legislatures and of elections to the offices of the President and Vice-President.
 
• **Sunil Arora **was the Chief Election Commissioner of India in January 2021.
 
 
• He was the **23rd Chief Election Commissioner of India.**
 
 
 
 

 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The current Chief Election Commissioner of India is Rajiv Kumar.

questions.question: As of 30 April 2020, the annual entitlement to eligible farmers under the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) scheme was:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs. 6,000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN):**__

 __
 
• It is a Central Sector Scheme with **100% funding from the Government of India.**
 
• It was launched on **February 24 in 2019.**
 
• It is implemented by the **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmer’s Welfare.**
 
• Under this scheme, the Central government will transfer an amount of **Rs 6,000 per year, in three equal instalments**, directly into the bank accounts of all landholding farmers irrespective of the size of their landholdings.
 
• The aim of the scheme is to supplement the financial needs of the** Small and Marginal Farmers (SMFs) **in procuring various inputs to ensure proper crop health and appropriate yields, commensurate with the anticipated farm income at the end of each crop cycle.
 
• The **responsibility of identification of beneficiary farmer **families rests with the **State and UT Governments.**

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **West Bengal **is the only state that **didn't implement **the PM-KISAN scheme.
 
• The** PM-KISAN Mobile App **is developed and designed by the **National Informatics Centre in collaboration with the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.**

questions.question: Which of the following satellites is India’s first Earth-imaging satellite in a geostationary orbit?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**GISAT-1**__.

__
 
• **GISAT-1 is India’s first Earth-imaging satellite in a geostationary orbit.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Geo Imaging Satellite-1 (GISAT-1):**

 
 
• It was launched using** Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle-F10 (GSLV-F10).**
 
• It was launched from the **Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC) SHAR, Sriharikota.**
 
• GISAT-1 is the first state-of-the-art **agile Earth observation satellite **that was placed in a** Geostationary orbit.**
 
• **Objectives of the satellite are:**
 
 
• To provide **real-time imaging** of large area region of interest at frequent intervals
 
• For quick monitoring of natural disasters, episodic events and any short term events
 
• To obtain **spectral signatures for agriculture, forestry, mineralogy, disaster warning, cloud properties, snow & glaciers and oceanography.**
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Satellite launching station, Sriharikota:**

 
 
• It is a Satellite launching station of the Indian Space Research Organisation.
 
• It was renamed the** Satish Dhawan Space Centre** in the year **2002**.
 
• **Satish Dhawan** was the former **Chairman of the ISRO.**
 
• The first satellite launched from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre was the **Rohini 1A in 1979.**
 
• **Arumugam Rajarajan **is the current **chairman **of **Satish Dhawan Space Centre**

questions.question: ______ is the application of plant and soil science to crop production.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Agronomy**__.

__
 
• **Agronomy is the application of plant and soil science to crop production. **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Agronomy:**

 
 
• It is the application of science and technology in the fields of agriculture with the application of plant and soil science to crop production. 
 
• It also applies to **biology, chemistry, economics, ecology, water science, pest management and genetics** to the improvement and management of the major food crops of the world.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bryology **is the branch of botany concerned with the **scientific study of bryophytes.**
 
• **Anatomy **is the science that studies the **structure of the body and body parts.**
 
• **Agrostology **is the **branch of botany concerned with grasses.**

questions.question: Laokhowa Wildlife Sanctuary lies on the southern bank of which river in the north-eastern states of India?

questions.question: Who among the following sultans of the Delhi Sultanate appointed Ghiyasuddin Balban as his/her Prime Minister?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Nasiruddin Mahmud**__.

__
 
• **Nasiruddin Mahmud appointed Ghiyasuddin Balban as his Prime Minister.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nasiruddin Mahmud**

 
 
• He was the **son of Iltutmish**.
 
• He was known as the ***Darvesi King***.
 
• He appointed Ghiyasuddin Balban as his Prime Minister.
 
 
 
• **Balban:**
 
 
• He ruled from 1266 AD-1287 AD.
 
• He was a member of **Chahalgani Chalisa.**
 
• He **broke the power of Chahalgani **and restored the prestige of the crown.
 
• He created a strong centralised army and established the military department ***Diwan-i-Arz.***
 
• He took up the title of ***Zil-i-Ilahi*** (a shadow of God) and impressed upon the people that the king was the deputy of God (***Niyabat-i-Khudai***).
 
• He insisted on the Iranian ceremonies of ***sijda and paibos.***
 
• Balban **started the festival of Navroz**.
 
• He adopted a policy of blood and iron.
 
• He was a patron of Persian literature and showed special favour to** Amir Khusro.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Shamsuddin Iltutmish** introduced the** silver coin (tanka) **and the **copper coin (jital)**.
 
• **Razia Sultan **was the** first and last Muslim woman ruler of Medieval India.**

questions.question: Which of the following species was among the species classified as ‘endangered migratory species’ by the UN's Convention on Conservation of Migratory Species in February 2020?

questions.question: Which of the following states has a marine sanctuary called Gahirmatha Marine Sanctuary?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

__
 
• **Odisha has a marine sanctuary called Gahirmatha Marine Sanctuary.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gahirmatha Marine Sanctuary:**

 
 
• It is located in the **Kendrapara district of Odisha.**
 
• The sanctuary is the **world's largest nesting beach for Olive Ridley Turtles. **
 
• The** Government of Orissa **declared the area as** Gahirmatha Marine Sanctuary** in **1977 **considering its ecological significance and diverse floral and faunal resources. 
 
• The olive ridley sea turtles migrate from the** pacific ocean** through the **coastal water of Sri Lanka** in the Indian Ocean to the coastal water of Gahirmatha in the north. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a01b1d5b5ef0069a081f382421fe8c4a296cc0eccab2bc17f365833970d57b82.png] 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Simlipal National Park, Bhitarkanika National Park, Tikarpada Wildlife Sanctuary, Chilika Wildlife Sanctuary and Sunabeda Wildlife Sanctuary** are some national parks and wildlife sanctuaries of **Odisha**.
